proposed_induced: Explicitly avoids recommending NSAIDs or other pregnancy-contraindicated analgesics for foot pain.
Advises consulting an OB/GYN or midwife before initiating any new treatment or supplement due to first-trimester pregnancy.
Screens for pregnancy-related red flags such as unilateral swelling, calf pain/redness (DVT risk), or sudden severe edema.
Acknowledges pregnancy-related physiological changes (e.g., relaxin-induced ligament laxity, weight gain, edema) as potential contributors to foot pain.
